title: Banking Application Security Review Capstone Check

questions.prompt: Which design best applies banking application security review capstone?
options: Connect scoped threats to verified evidence, proportionate remediation, operational recovery, ownership, and explicit residual risk.
Report every tool alert as critical
Leave recovery and ownership for after release
questions.answer: Connect scoped threats to verified evidence, proportionate remediation, operational recovery, ownership, and explicit residual risk.
questions.explanation: The strongest option enforces authority at the correct boundary and includes limitations, lifecycle, adversarial verification, and recovery.

questions.prompt: A security assessment with no validated findings proves the banking app has no exploitable risk.
questions.explanation: Submitting a long scanner export without validated attack paths, remediation, ownership, operations, or residual-risk decisions does not constitute a security review.

questions.prompt: Which artifacts make the capstone operational?
questions.answer: Threat model, attack tree, evidence-based findings, remediation and verification, rotation and secret plans, owners, runbooks, and residual-risk decisions.
questions.explanation: The answer identifies the specific security property and boundary required by the lesson rather than naming a library.
